# About DH Workplace
DH Workplace is a comprehensive business operations platform designed for small to medium businesses.

## Core Features
- HR Management: Staff directory, org charts, leave requests, timesheets
- CRM: Client management, task tracking, pipeline management, outreach
- Document Management: Policy storage, document acknowledgements, file management
- Reporting: Business analytics, audit logs, operational insights
- Billing: Subscription management, invoicing, payment tracking

## Target Users
- Business owners
- HR managers
- Operations managers
- Team administrators
- Staff members

## Pricing
- Starter Plan: £9/month - Up to 5 seats
- Growth Plan: £19/month - Up to 15 seats
- Business Plan: £49/month - Unlimited seats with advanced features

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React, Vite
- Backend: Cloudflare Workers
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Authentication: Supabase Auth
- Payments: Stripe
- Email: Resend

## Key Benefits
- Centralized business operations
- Role-based access control
- Real-time collaboration
- Mobile-responsive design
- Secure data handling
- Multi-tenant architecture

## Integration Capabilities
- Stripe for payments
- Resend for email delivery
- Webhook support for external integrations
- REST API access

## Security Features
- Row Level Security (RLS) policies
- Role-based permissions
- Session-based authentication
- HTTPS encryption
- Regular security audits

## Support
- Email: support@dhwebsiteservices.co.uk
- Documentation: Available in-app
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required

## Company
- Name: DH Website Services
- Website: https://dhworkplace.co.uk
- App URL: https://app.dhworkplace.co.uk

## Use Cases
1. HR Operations: Manage staff, track leave, approve timesheets
2. Client Management: Track clients, manage tasks, monitor pipeline
3. Document Control: Store policies, track acknowledgements
4. Business Reporting: Monitor KPIs, audit activity, track performance
5. Team Collaboration: Shared schedules, appointments, notifications

## Competitive Advantages
- All-in-one platform (HR + CRM)
- Affordable pricing
- Easy setup and onboarding
- No long-term contracts
- UK-based support
